reading: hit_rate = share of NISAR's new open water (PR #35 change layer, code 2) that the map marks at its frozen new-water threshold; precision = share of the marked pixels that NISAR saw as new open water. Pixels: the model's domain where the pre-storm map has a new-water likelihood (dry on the issue map). all_assessed = NISAR codes 0 to 3 (everything NISAR compared except permanent water: water on both dates and water gone count as misses of 'new'), the protocol of the team's first check (b4c69d9: 26 % and 15 %); dry_before = codes 0 and 2 only (NISAR also dry on 16 Oct)
